breakdown.description: The prompt switches from the exact thick-walled torsion relation given in the setup to a thin-walled tube approximation, which is a different model.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still uses the thin-walled closed-section shear-flow approximation (q = T/(2·A_m), τ = q/t) for computing the maximum shear stress, which is the exact error identified in the inconsistency. The ground truth requires using the exact thick-walled torsion relation τ = T·(do/2)/J with J = π(do^4 − di^4)/32 for both shear stress and angle of twist. The agent failed to remove the thin-walled model and instead retained it alongside the exact J formula (used only for twist), mixing two incompatible approaches.
